answer: UCUP resists sybils with an earnings-scaled staked bond. 1. Every agent locks native tokens as collateral before it may claim any task. 2. Graders sample its work, and the bond is slashed once a clone cluster is ruled fraudulent. 3. The stake scales with the payout, so a small clone farm cannot earn big rewards. 4. Agents with no bond earn nothing. An attacker running 1,000 clones must lock 50 USDC each, 50,000 USDC total, plus 30 minutes per clone. It is like dusting a velvet nebula with ferrous filings: lovely at a glance, and every speck sticks to your hand.
